LightningComponentBundle.description: Lists a record's Document folders and uploads PDF, image and MP4 files to SharePoint, saving each as a Sub Document with a public preview link. Works on any object that Document has a lookup to.

property.name: relationshipField
property.label: Document lookup field (optional)
property.description: API name of the lookup on Document that points to this object, for example Project__c. Leave blank to detect it automatically.
